# 🚀 Featured Projects & Portfolio

## Current Projects

### 1. 📱 Blog Me - Premium Developer Portfolio
**Status**: In Active Development ✨  
**Repository**: [Ranji-07/blog_me_07](https://github.com/Ranji-07/blog_me_07)

#### Overview
A premium, highly-interactive, and fully data-driven developer portfolio web application designed to showcase technical skills through a cinematic, modern aesthetic.

#### Tech Stack
```
Frontend:  Dart (70.8%) • Flutter • UI/UX Design
Backend:   Python (15.1%) • FastAPI • Data Management
Native:    C++ (6.9%) • C (0.4%) • Swift (0.6%) • Performance Optimization
Build:     CMake (5.5%) • Compilation
```

#### Key Features
- ⭐ Cinematic and immersive design
- 🎨 Interactive animations and transitions
- 📊 Real-time data-driven content
- 🎯 Project showcase with detailed portfolios
- 📈 Performance metrics and statistics
- 🔐 Secure data handling
- 📱 Fully responsive design
- ⚡ High-performance native components

#### Architecture Highlights
- **Frontend**: Cross-platform Flutter application with custom animations
- **Backend**: Python FastAPI for REST APIs and data management
- **Performance**: C++ native modules for computationally intensive tasks
- **Database**: PostgreSQL with optimized queries
- **Caching**: Redis for session and data caching
- **Storage**: AWS S3 for media assets

#### Learning Outcomes
- Cross-platform mobile development with Flutter
- Backend architecture with Python
- Native performance optimization
- Full-stack integration patterns
- Database design and optimization

### 2. 🛍️ React E-Commerce Application
**Status**: Active Development 🚀  
**Repository**: [Ranji-07/Reactjs-E-commerce-Application](https://github.com/Ranji-07/Reactjs-E-commerce-Application)

#### Overview
A production-ready e-commerce platform featuring modern architecture, comprehensive product catalog, secure checkout, and seamless user experience across all devices.

#### Tech Stack
```
Frontend:  React 18+ • JavaScript/TypeScript • Responsive Design
Backend:   Node.js • Express.js • RESTful APIs
Database:  PostgreSQL • Redis (Caching)
Infra:     Docker • Kubernetes • AWS
CI/CD:     GitHub Actions • Docker Registry
```

#### Key Features
- 🛒 Comprehensive product catalog with advanced filtering
- 🛍️ Persistent shopping cart with local storage
- 💳 Secure checkout with payment gateway integration
- 👤 User authentication and authorization (JWT)
- 📦 Order tracking and history
- 📱 Fully responsive mobile-first design
- 🔍 Advanced search with Elasticsearch
- ⚡ Performance optimization and lazy loading
- 📊 Admin dashboard with analytics
- 🔐 Security best practices (HTTPS, CSP, XSS protection)

#### Architecture Highlights
- **Frontend**: Component-based React with hooks and context
- **State Management**: Redux Toolkit for global state
- **APIs**: RESTful design with error handling
- **Backend**: Microservices-ready Node.js architecture
- **Database**: Normalized PostgreSQL schema
- **Caching**: Redis for performance optimization
- **Security**: OAuth 2.0, JWT tokens, encrypted passwords

#### DevOps Setup
- **Containerization**: Multi-stage Docker builds
- **Orchestration**: Kubernetes deployment manifests
- **CI/CD**: GitHub Actions for automated testing and deployment
- **Monitoring**: Prometheus and Grafana dashboards
- **Logging**: ELK stack for centralized logging

#### Learning Outcomes
- Full-stack React development
- Backend API design and implementation
- Database optimization and scaling
- Docker containerization and Kubernetes deployment
- CI/CD pipeline automation
- Security best practices implementation
